title: Pool Service Scheduling Software 2026: 6 Tools, Real Prices
description: Pool scheduling software compared: Skimmer, Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager, GorillaDesk, Jobber, Housecall Pro. Route tools and prices from vendor pages.
h1: Pool service scheduling software: what each tool actually does
body:
Pool scheduling is mostly recurring weekly routes plus a stream of one-off repairs, openings and closings. Below is what six tools say about scheduling and routing on their own pricing pages, checked 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-30. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. For the wider pool software picture (billing and chemistry), see best pool service software and the pool service hub.

{{table:skimmer,pool-brain,pool-office-manager,gorilladesk}}

Scheduling features at a glance

1. Skimmer: per-pool pricing, optimization on Scaling Up

Getting Started ($1 per serviced location, starts at $49/mo) includes Route Builder and one-time work orders. The full Schedule, recurring work orders and Route Optimization are on Scaling Up ($2 per serviced location, starts at $98/mo). Both plans include unlimited technicians and admins, and locations you don't service in a month aren't billed (Skimmer pricing). Full breakdown: Skimmer pricing. {{aff:skimmer|See Skimmer plans}}

2. Pool Brain: route optimization on its single plan

Pool Brain sells one all-features plan: a $50/mo base that covers unlimited office users, plus $65/mo per active field technician (its page example: 5 techs = $375/mo). Its features page lists one-click route optimization, drag-and-drop scheduling, one-time moves and an Unscheduled section. Trial length and contract terms aren't published. See Pool Brain pricing. {{aff:poolbrain|Visit Pool Brain}}

3. Pool Office Manager: four schedule views, per-user pricing

Pool Office Manager (POM) is $125/mo for the first user and $25/mo per additional active user, month to month, and users can be deactivated in the off-season. Scheduling includes Timeline, Map, Combined and Calendar views, drag-and-drop assignment, recurring appointments, route optimization and an Unassigned queue. It has a 30-day free trial with a card entered at signup (POM pricing). See Pool Office Manager pricing. {{aff:poolofficemanager|Visit Pool Office Manager}}

4. GorillaDesk: priced per route

GorillaDesk charges per route with unlimited users: Basic $49/mo, Pro $99/mo, Growth $149/mo for one route. Basic routing is capped at 25 stops, which matters for a full pool route; Pro adds Drive Matrix routing. See GorillaDesk pricing. {{aff:gorilladesk|Visit GorillaDesk}}

5 and 6. Jobber and Housecall Pro: general field service tools

Neither lists pool chemistry tools on its pricing page, but both schedule recurring work. Housecall Pro puts routes on Essentials ($149/mo billed annually, 5 users) and one-click route optimization on MAX. See Housecall Pro pricing and Jobber vs Housecall Pro.

Monthly cost for a 1-tech and 5-tech pool company (list prices)

  • Pool Brain: 1 tech = $50 + $65 = $115/mo; 5 techs = $375/mo (vendor example).
  • Pool Office Manager: 1 user = $125/mo; 5 users = $125 + 4 × $25 = $225/mo.
  • Skimmer: depends on pools, not people. 80 serviced pools on Scaling Up = 80 × $2 = $160/mo; on Getting Started = $80/mo (but no route optimization).
  • GorillaDesk Pro: 1 route = $99/mo; each extra route +$50/mo.

These exclude add-ons, card fees and tax. Estimating jobs too? Try our job quote estimator and the software buying checklist.
faq: What is the best pool service scheduling software?

It depends on how you grow. Skimmer bills per serviced pool with unlimited techs; Pool Brain and Pool Office Manager bill per tech or user; GorillaDesk bills per route. All four list route optimization on at least one plan (Skimmer on Scaling Up, GorillaDesk Drive Matrix on Pro), per vendor pages checked October 2026.
Which pool software has route optimization?
Skimmer (Scaling Up), Pool Brain, Pool Office Manager and Housecall Pro (MAX) list route optimization on their pages. GorillaDesk lists Drive Matrix routing on Pro.
How much does pool scheduling software cost?

Published starting prices: Skimmer from $49/mo ($1 per serviced location), GorillaDesk $49/mo per route, Pool Brain $50/mo base plus $65 per field tech, Pool Office Manager $125/mo for the first user plus $25 per extra user.
Can I pause users in the off-season?
Pool Office Manager says you can deactivate users in the off-season and stop paying for them the next month. Skimmer doesn't bill for locations you don't service in a month.
